accounting_contract.byte_ledger: Track every actual emitted byte including partial syscalls, copies, snapshots, logs, temporary files, metadata, checksums and seal; deletions never refund emitted-byte allowance. Also report final retained bytes separately. Unknown exact totals are null with conservative bounds and integrity failure.
accounting_contract.cpu: Controller process CPU plus all live and reaped child/process-group CPU, without double counting. Include sampling/probe helpers launched inside the attempt. Use conservative live growth between observations; inability to bound live CPU fails closed. Record sampled and reaped peak RSS with limitations.
accounting_contract.no_forecast: Original ceilings are unchanged; accounting fixes are not a performance result or permission to increase budgets.
accounting_contract.terminal: Reserve closure capacity before work. Keep first work error and later closeout errors distinct. Do not repeat full custody during terminal closeout. Post-seal read-only custody cannot erase within-attempt failures.

campaign.accounting: One measured attempt includes custody, saved-input verification/copy, snapshots, worker, report, independent replay and event extraction, guards, inventories and seal. Compilation and invented structural tests precede the clock. Count controller and all child CPU and all emitted file bytes, including snapshots and failure receipts.
campaign.launch_policy: Before each stage reserve full stage wall allowance plus5s, twice that allowance plus5s in aggregate CPU, output allowance and64MiB final metadata reserve. Stop at first failed reservation. Independently enforce aggregate caps during stages and controller operations; reserve closure capacity before first transition.
campaign.rss_policy: sampled enforcement plus reaped peak check; not a hard instantaneous memory bound

closed_environment_limits: initial activation 64, no supply; each birth burns activation, so at most 64 births per trajectory conservatively; free state/edge changes can persist and do not establish sustained constructive turnover
control_policy: Invented event/world descriptors and mocked process stages only before execution admission; no concrete candidate enumeration, transition interpreter, retained-world execution or keyed calls in tests. Original P01f witness results remain evidence, never rerun. Runtime replay is admitted only as part of the future single registered attempt.

decision.both_pass: eligible to propose a fresh bounded development protocol; no automatic E01, longer run, seed expansion, driven environment or scientific claim
decision.engineering_failure_or_incomplete: stop; retain every case and diagnose infrastructure, censoring or feasibility; no expansion or completion of missing cells under this registration
decision.engineering_pass_mechanism_fail: stop this distribution's escalation; retain zeros and frozen gates; read-only diagnosis before any separately justified redesign

engineering_gate: all128 fixed trajectories complete128epochs with no missing/censored/failed/replaced cells
all saved input streams and original seals match; identical law table across each four-initial group; all immutable source/dependency/tool/binary identities match

unchanged Rust worker/report and independent original Python replay plus single-pass adapter agree on candidates, scheduling, dependencies, world states, ledgers, cap justification and every detector record
event evidence is derived from committed before/after state differences with exact event/node/edge IDs; separate event-observation auditor agrees without importing the primary extractor
all fixed invented controls pass before admission; all stage/aggregate cost ceilings, inventories and seals pass
failure_policy: Probe process/RSS/CPU capability before creating the attempt directory. Creation consumes the one attempt even before transitions. Initialize all128 rows and384 stage slots before launch. Stop on first stage/cell/reservation/integrity failure; preserve complete prefix, failed/censored cell, unstarted suffix, partial streams and missingness. No retry, resume, extension, replacement, input repair, regeneration, law selection or changed threshold. Preserve P01q unchanged.

mechanism_gate.additional_funding_and_descendant_constr: secondary descriptive endpoints; not substituted for the primary loop or imposed as extra acceptance thresholds
mechanism_gate.eligible_observations: complete independently verified trajectories only; one qualifying table counts once even when multiple proposals or initial states share it
mechanism_gate.rationale: small engineering continuation criterion requiring repeatable access to detector-visible birth across distinct sampled tables plus one within-trajectory recycling example; not a statistical significance threshold or life criterion

observables.additional_structural_funding: later committed form-3 Structural Transfer has an actual earlier-born node as recipient; exclude the Transfer internal to its birth; retain transferred matter and activation
observables.attached_funded_birth: committed form-4 event creates a fresh node, a donor-to-child Structural edge, child free matter >=1 and activation >=1; record event ID, donor and created node ID
observables.cleanup_events: For each committed form6/7, record exact removed Structural edge ID and ordered endpoints, node deletion/preservation, donor/recipient balances and dissipated activation. Link endpoints to earlier births where present; cleanup6 can orphan G while it remains live.
observables.descendant_construction: committed form-4 birth has an actual earlier-born node as its donor/account; record both birth event IDs; this construction relation is not biological ancestry or causal reproduction
observables.full_detector_record: unchanged original Rust/Python environment detector output for every retained prefix; full-horizon AP null on censoring; never choose one estimator to replace disagreement
observables.newborn_recycling: committed form-7 deletion removes a node created in an earlier retained birth event in this same trajectory; record creation/deletion IDs and refund recipient
observables.ordered_branch: Secondary descriptive endpoint, no admission threshold: same distinct P,C,G in one cell; ordered events birth P->C, two subsequent form3 matter1 Structural transfers P->C, birth C->G, form6/7 removal of that C->G creation edge, then form7 recycle C to P using surviving P->C creation edge. Require creation edges survive until their named cleanup and at least the two funding events precede C birth. Enumerate all qualifying event tuples, deduplicate counts by (P,C,G,cleanup form); retain tuple evidence, intervening events and actual phase balances. Do not require isolated-branch predicted balances when intervening events occur; report net changes and total burns separately. This is temporal co-occurrence, not causal necessity or reproduction.
observables.orphaning: record when an actual newborn remains live with no incident Structural edge after a committed event
observables.visible_birth: an actual attached funded newborn belongs to at least one eligible connected proposal and at least one eligible interaction proposal at the same retained sample while live; record sample and both proposals; this is eligibility only
observables.visible_birth_recycle_loop: the same created node satisfies attached_funded_birth, visible_birth and later newborn_recycling within one trajectory; do not pool different nodes, initial states or laws

prior_knowledge: P01p found a conditional cleanup7 branch in law6011; P01q failed before any native stage. P01t/u/v establish request transport, validator acceptance and inert orchestration only. All32 laws remain included. Finite closed activation limits constructive turnover; no reproduction or causal necessity claim.

production_contracts.loader: Verify existing P01t request bytes and both original saved streams; initial is the entire environment containing native, never the saved wrapper. Never call P01q saved_initial, verify or main.
production_contracts.report_cap_justification: Rust reporter and Python replay may compute the next epoch on censored inputs; these calls are world execution and are forbidden before execution admission.

reporting.costs: report aggregate measured pipeline CPU/wall/bytes and each stage's CPU/wall/RSS/output; per-run median, nearest-rank p95 and maximum; no whole-campaign forecast from witness timing
reporting.denominators: All32 law cells and128 trajectories; all negatives, censored, failed and unstarted cells retained; four initials nested within law.
reporting.interpretation: Fixed v4 panel with authored correlations and known static outcomes. Descriptive fractions only; no paired v3/v4 superiority, isolated state-versus-matter effect, population estimate or causal claim.
reporting.law_identity: SHA-256 of canonical ordered eight-rule list omitting only id fields; retain duplicate bodies and tables, count distinct tables separately.
reporting.missingness: report observed prefix mechanisms as lower-bound observations; unobserved full-horizon metrics are null with reason, never false or silently excluded
reporting.unit: Proposal ID is law unit; initial states nested, not128 independent replicates.

requirements_before_execution: Commit/push P01w registration and its source/input freeze before implementing only the listed new paths.

Freeze authored expected controls before tests. Test only invented descriptors and inert/mock process contracts, normal and optimized rejection paths. No retained request parsing, candidate enumeration, transition interpreter, worker/reporter/replay execution or keyed calls during implementation tests.

Retain all implementation/test attempts with source identities. Implementation corrections may repeat only invented controls into fresh directories before the productive attempt; they never permit repeating a consumed dynamics attempt.

Require all registered production contracts, original mechanism controls, guard/accounting/missingness tests and independent receipt-audit mutations to pass. Preserve original full independent Python replay plus single-pass verification; detector disagreement stays inconclusive.

Separately freeze full source, all transitive Python dependencies including existing bytecode, tools, dynamic libraries, unchanged production binaries, all fixed input bytes and complete memberships. Verify tests used that closure. Commit/push execution freeze/admission and exact command/output before any candidate or transition computation.

Read-only execution admission verifies all128 request hashes, both streams per cell, original seals and prior native/inert receipts. Capability probes precede output creation; custody/snapshots/copies after creation count inside campaign limits.

After the one attempt, independently audit preserved receipts/inventories and arithmetic without world replay, generator calls, campaign imports or subprocesses; retain an inconclusive/integrity-failed outcome on disagreement.
